description.zh:
- 版本类型，必须选择一个版本

- 通用版本：translate_standard

- 专业版本：translate_ecommerce
description.en:
- The edition type. You must specify an edition.

- General-purpose Edition: \`translate\_standard\`

- Professional Edition: \`translate\_ecommerce\`

description.zh: 翻译文本的格式，html（ 网页格式。设置此参数将对待翻译文本以及翻译后文本按照html格式进行处理）、text（文本格式。设置此参数将对传入待翻译文本以及翻译后结果不做文本格式处理，统一按纯文本格式处理。
description.en: The format of the text to translate. \`html\`: The source and translated text are processed as HTML. \`text\`: The source and translated text are processed as plain text.

description.zh:
- 专业版本支持的场景：商品标题（title），商品描述（description），商品沟通（communication），医疗（medical），社交（social）

- 通用版本支持的场景：general
description.en:
- Scenarios supported by the Professional Edition: product titles (\`title\`), product descriptions (\`description\`), customer communication (\`communication\`), medical (\`medical\`), and social (\`social\`).

- Scenario supported by the General-purpose Edition: \`general\`.

description.zh:
json 数据格式

key：唯一的标记id，用于翻译结果拿到对应的id，对应上原文

value：待翻译的内容

具体格式如下：
`
{
  "11": "hello boy",
  "12": "go home",
  "13": "we can"
}
`

> 待翻译的条数不能超过50
> 单条翻译字符数不能超过1000字符
> 总字符数不能超过8000字符
>key不会计入翻译的字符
>待翻译的内容中，标点、空格、html标签均会计入字符
description.en:
The source text to translate, in JSON format.

key: A unique ID to map the translation result to the source text.

value: The content to translate.

The format is as follows: `{ "11": "hello boy", "12": "go home", "13": "we can" }`

> The number of text segments cannot exceed 50. The length of a single text segment cannot exceed 1,000 characters. The total number of characters cannot exceed 8,000. The key is not included in the character count. Punctuation, spaces, and HTML tags in the content are included in the character count.

descriptions.en:
1\. The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 50. To request a limit increase, contact us in DingTalk group 23369411. <props="china">2. The maximum length of a single text segment is 1,000 characters. You can translate up to 50 segments in a single request. If your content exceeds these limits, save it to a file and use [Document Translation](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164151.html).</props>
<props="china">3. Before you use this API, review the billing methods and pricing for the General-purpose and Professional editions.</props>
<props="china">4. You can use the Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI Developer Portal to [test](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/alimt/2018-10-12/GetBatchTranslate) this API call.</props>
